question: Whether paper Render Full can be independently reconstructed as a bounded rendering cache from arXiv v4 and the pinned released source without outcome-dominating assumptions.
answer: The cache concept is partly specified, but render-specific compatibility, capacity accounting, reduction, ordering, cache-state, and timing semantics are not uniquely recoverable. Paper-compatible SPT-cut reuse also conflicts with the predeclared exact-evaluator-semantic validation.

paper.title: A LoD of Gaussians: Out-of-Core Training and Rendering for Seamless Ultra-Large Scene Reconstruction
relevant_locations: Supplementary Sections A.1, A.4, and A.7
paper.explicit_cache_entry: SPT cut plus cached camera-to-root distance

source.viewer_policy: immediately previous compatible SPT working-set reuse without a bounded retained cache
source.training_policy: bounded retained mutable SPT-cut cache with write-back and periodic clearing

core_unresolved_semantics: reduced capacity and eviction trigger timing
decisive_conflict: Paper-compatible cached SPT reuse may change selected detail, while the predeclared reconstruction gate required exact fresh-evaluator selected IDs and raster inputs.

comparison_impact.qualification: ALOD-EXT remains compared with the faithful no-cache project baseline, not paper Render Full.
